sources.search_query: Qatar official immigration tourist visa portal.moi.gov.qa
sources.relevant_excerpt: Citizens from more than 95 countries around the world are permitted to enter Qatar with a visa upon arrival. Entry requirements include a valid passport with minimum three months' validity, a confirmed onward/return ticket, and compulsory health insurance from Ministry of Public Health-registered providers. Tourist visa categories are offered via the Hayya platform: Tourist Visa, entry visas for GCC residents, visas for those accompanying GCC citizens, and Entry Visa via Electronic Travel Authorization (ETA).

The specific eligible-country lists and stay durations are presented via a linked sub-page rendered client-side and were not retrievable as text.

Contact aimmig@moi.gov.qa. The specific country lists within each category were on client-side-rendered sub-pages and not retrievable as text.

sources.search_query: official Qatar electronic travel authorization eligibility
sources.relevant_excerpt: The ETA is granted to any nationality holding a valid residence permit or visa in the following countries: the UK, USA, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, Schengen countries, and GCC nations. Required documents: proof of hotel booking or other accommodation, return or onboard ticket, copy of passport valid for not less than six months, and a copy of the residence permit or entry visa to the countries mentioned above valid for not less than 30 days. It allows travellers to obtain a visa upon arrival for a stay of up to 30 days, extendable online for another 30 days for use during the same visit. Applications are submitted through www.qatarvisaservice.com; the applicant receives an e-notification valid for 30 days, renewable online.

sources.search_query: Qatar MOI seafarers immediate entry visa
sources.relevant_excerpt: Visa for seafarers: an immediate entry visa granted through accredited maritime tourist agencies, issued for sea activities only, with a maximum stay of 4 days (96 hours). Requires a valid passport.

sources.search_query: Qatar MOI tips guidelines for visitors visa extension medical
sources.relevant_excerpt: When entering the country on a visit visa, the visitor must confirm the duration of the visit granted to him according to the type of visit visa. For a family visit the visitor is granted one month. Visitors wishing to extend beyond one month must complete medical checkup procedures before their visa expires or face a fine of QR 200 for each day of delay (maximum QR 12,000).

sources.search_query: visitqatar.com entry visa requirements visa-free countries
sources.relevant_excerpt: Travelers from various countries are eligible for visa-free entry to Qatar; visa-free entry to 102 nationalities. Nationals of the Gulf Cooperation Council countries (Bahrain, Kuwait, Oman, Saudi Arabia and United Arab Emirates) do not require a visa to enter Qatar. Visas can be applied for on the Hayya platform for a cost of QAR 100. The visitor's passport must be valid for at least three months from the date of arrival in Qatar. Stay duration under visa-free entry can be either 30 days or 90 days depending on nationality.

sources.search_query: official Qatar Hayya tourist evisa GCC visa free
sources.relevant_excerpt: All GCC nationals are welcome to visit Qatar without a visa. All you need is your passport or GCC ID. The Hayya platform offers Hayya Tourist E-Visas and different types of visas, with a Track your E-Visa feature and a Hayya mobile app for managing applications.

conditions: GCC nationals enter without a visa using a valid passport or GCC ID

policies.policy_name: Visa-free entry / visa on arrival (visa waiver)
policies.description: Qatar grants visa-free entry (a free waiver issued on arrival) to citizens of around 100-102 nationalities for tourism. Stay is either 30 days or 90 days depending on nationality; the 30-day waiver is extendable for a further 30 days. Requires a passport valid at least 3 months from arrival, a confirmed onward/return ticket, and compulsory health insurance from a Ministry of Public Health-registered provider. The waiver is free of charge. GCC nationals (Bahrain, Kuwait, Oman, Saudi Arabia, UAE) enter without any visa on passport or GCC ID. The specific 90-day and 30-day country lists are published on the MOI portal but are rendered client-side and could not be extracted as verifiable text during this research.
conditions: Passport valid at least 3 months from date of arrival
Compulsory health insurance from an MoPH-registered provider
Stay is 30 or 90 days depending on nationality; 30-day waiver extendable for another 30 days

policies.description: Facilitation allowing travellers of any nationality who hold a valid residence permit or entry visa in the UK, USA, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, a Schengen country, or a GCC nation to obtain a visa upon arrival. Grants a stay of up to 30 days, extendable online for another 30 days for the same visit. Requires proof of accommodation, a return/onward ticket, a passport valid at least 6 months, and the residence permit/entry visa valid at least 30 days. Applied for via www.qatarvisaservice.com.
conditions: Holder of valid residence permit or entry visa in UK, USA, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, Schengen, or GCC
Residence permit/entry visa valid at least 30 days
Proof of accommodation and return/onward ticket required
policies.maximum_stay: 30 days, extendable online for another 30 days

policies.description: Nationalities not eligible for visa-free entry or an ETA apply before travel for a tourist visa through the official Hayya platform (hayya.qa / Hayya mobile app) at a cost of QAR 100. Hayya also handles GCC-resident and GCC-companion entry visas.
conditions: Applied for online via the Hayya platform prior to travel
